key_information_units.information: Group revenue increased to EUR 1.837 billion in 2025 (from EUR 1.372 billion in 2024), with EBITDA rising to EUR 228 million (from EUR 145 million) and net profit of EUR 69.9 million (from EUR 193.7 million). Total assets grew to EUR 2.597 billion with equity at EUR 1.175 billion.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Key Figures of 2025 section, Management Report Overview

key_information_units.information: The revenue and EBITDA growth was primarily driven by the full-year consolidation of Tallink Grupp (acquired in August 2024), improved performance at Elenger Grupp, and contributions from newly consolidated agriculture assets including Estonia Farmid and Halinga.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Key Figures of 2025 commentary, Events in 2025 (Tallink, Energy, Agriculture sections)

key_information_units.information: The maritime transport segment carried 5.53 million passengers (0.9% decrease YoY), with cargo units down 19.2% to 245,004 and passenger vehicles down 2.2% to 760,473. Vessel chartering balanced seasonal revenue fluctuations, and technical upgrades focused on reducing CO₂ emissions.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Events in 2025 - Maritime transport business segment

key_information_units.information: The energy segment delivered 18 TWh of LNG to Inkoo and Klaipėda terminals (unchanged YoY) with a market share of approximately 25% in the Finnish-Baltic region. Investments included a new 4.9 MW solar plant in Latvia and an 8 MWh battery storage facility, with plans for additional storage in Estonia.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Events in 2025 - Energy business segment, Management Report Overview

key_information_units.information: Real estate developments included completion of the 25,000 m² Rimi logistics centre in Laagri and commencement of construction for a 30,000 m² Depo DIY retail space in Lasnamäe. INF Infra secured a EUR 67.2 million contract for Rail Baltica mainline construction on the Kangru-Saku section.
Infortar acquired Estonia Farmid OÜ, gaining control of a major dairy farming and cereals operation, expanding its agriculture segment with the transaction completed on 7 July 2025.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Events in 2025 - Changes in Infortar's supporting sectors (agriculture acquisition details)

key_information_units.information: Liquidity improved to EUR 219.8 million (from EUR 167.6 million) with loan liabilities decreasing to EUR 1.071 billion (from EUR 1.223 billion). The net debt/EBITDA ratio improved to 3.7 (from 4.0). Dividends increased to EUR 62 million (EUR 3 per share) and a share buyback programme repurchased 16,988 shares in Q4 2025.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Key Figures of 2025, Share and shareholders section

key_information_units.information: Strategic initiatives focused on portfolio diversification, particularly expanding into agriculture and renewable energy, with investments in biomethane production and solar power to enhance long-term resilience and align with climate goals.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Letter from the CEO, Events in 2025 (agriculture acquisitions, renewable investments)
